items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: I went to Papa Teo and I played and I stayed with him until he took sick.

ctx.x: Then you took up the clarinet and went to Teo.
Yeah. After I gave that up. Was that Papa Teo?

items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Teo used to play with Tuxedo Band when I used to play with Tuxedo Band.

ctx.x: How old were you when you started?
How old were you? About how big a boy were you when you started? Who me? In music. Oh.
